bow.desc: A bow crafted by a previous survivor.

composite bow.desc: A composite bow manufactured for sport before the fall.

recurve bow.desc: A recurve bow designed and created for professional use before the fall.

crossbow.desc: A crossbow crafted by a survivor like you.

MGH22 Casual.desc: A handgun designed and manufactured by the Machining Guild back in 2022. As the name suggests, it is used for casual purposes, whatever that is.

MGR30 Special.desc: An assault rifle designed and manufactured by the Machining Guild back in 2030. It had widespread popularity across many police units and the military.

MGR31 Monster.desc: A full auto machine gun designed and manufactured by the Machining Guild back in 2031. Very unwieldy, but it's firepower is undeniable.

USLR MK7.desc: A laser rifle developed by the US military. It's the most common archetype deployed in almost every military base.

spear.desc: A spear capable of attacking from afar.

cutlass.desc: A cutlass made of real steel. Weapons like these are invaluable nowadays.

bat.desc: A wooden bat. It's very light.

pipe.desc: A metal pipe. It's hollow and light, and a bit unwieldy.

knife.desc: A rusty metal knife. Still pretty sharp.

rucksack.desc: A rucksack. Heavy, but can carry a lot inside.

backpack.desc: A backpack. Allows you to carry more items.

looter coat.desc: A tattered coat favored by looters. Provides some storage and armor.

leather armor.desc: A leather armor. Tough but lacks storage.

suit.desc: A fancy suit with many pockets.

gi.desc: Clothing worn by the martially adept.

scalemail.desc: A tough armor layered with thin metallic scales.

hood.desc: A hood to hide your identity.
